errors.busy.heading.description: Short phrase at the top of the server-busy card, shown while the server is turning requests away to recover from overload.

errors.busy.message.defaultMessage: Servidor indisponível Aguarde alguns segundos e recarregue a página.
errors.busy.message.description: Explains the server-busy error. The wait is short (seconds), and reloading is the remedy.

errors.busy.subtitle.description: One line naming the server-busy error.

errors.fallback.heading.description: Short phrase at the top of the card for any other error.

errors.fallback.message.defaultMessage: Verifique o endereço e tente novamente. Se o problema persistir, dirija-se à mesa de suporte
errors.fallback.message.description: Explains any other error and where to get help at the event.

errors.fallback.subtitle.defaultMessage: Não foi possível concluir sua solicitação
errors.fallback.subtitle.description: One line naming any other error.

errors.homeAction.description: Button on an error page that goes to the start. It lands on check-in without a session and on the pass with one; under /admin it goes to the admin home.

errors.internal.heading.defaultMessage: Erro inesperado. Dirija-se à mesa de suporte
errors.internal.heading.description: Short phrase at the top of the server-error card.

errors.internal.message.defaultMessage: Ocorreu um erro interno no servidor. Tente novamente em alguns instantes
errors.internal.message.description: Explains a server error in plain language.

errors.internal.subtitle.description: One line naming a server error.

errors.notFound.heading.description: Large glyph at the top of the page-not-found card.

errors.notFound.message.defaultMessage: O conteúdo que você está tentando acessar não existe ou foi removido.
errors.notFound.message.description: Explains a missing page in plain language.

errors.notFound.subtitle.description: One line naming a missing page.

errors.rateLimited.heading.description: Short phrase at the top of the too-many-requests card. The page exists because the visitor is retrying too fast, so it has no retry button.

errors.rateLimited.message.defaultMessage: Muitas tentativas em pouco tempo. Aguarde alguns instantes e tente novamente.
errors.rateLimited.message.description: Explains the too-many-requests error when the wait is not known.

errors.rateLimited.messageWithRetry.defaultMessage: Muitas tentativas em pouco tempo. Aguarde alguns instantes e tente novamente. {unit, select, seconds {Tente novamente em {count, number} segundos.} minutes {Tente novamente em {count, plural, one {# minuto} other {# minutos}}.} other {Tente novamente em {count, number} segundos.}}
errors.rateLimited.messageWithRetry.description: Explains the too-many-requests error when the wait is known. unit is seconds for a wait of a minute or less, and minutes (rounded up) beyond that; count is the wait in that unit.

errors.rateLimited.subtitle.description: One line naming the too-many-requests error.

errors.title.description: Browser tab title of an error page. subtitle is the error's one-line summary; appTitle is the application's configured name.
